---
title: "Outreach"
toc: false
---

LEDT shares knowledge about Amazonian trees and forests beyond the classroom, through open materials, data-analysis training and community activities. The materials below are in Portuguese.

-   **R Lab** – commented, reproducible R routines for phytosociology, NIR spectroscopy, occurrence maps and more. [Go to R Lab](../extensao/rlab/index.html){.btn .btn-outline-success .btn-sm}
-   **FenoTree** – LEDT's online app that builds flowering and fruiting calendars of trees from speciesLink herbarium records; nothing to install. [Learn more (PT)](../extensao/ferramentas.html){.btn .btn-outline-success .btn-sm} [Open the app](https://ledtufam.shinyapps.io/fenotree/){.btn .btn-outline-success .btn-sm}
-   **UFAM campus flora** – a survey of the trees on the UFAM campus carried out by Tropical Dendrology students, which will become an **e-book** on the campus tree flora *(in progress)*.
-   **Science communication** – news, behind the scenes of fieldwork and lab, and publications explained in plain language. [See posts](../divulgacaocientifica.html){.btn .btn-outline-success .btn-sm}
-   **Courses and workshops** – short courses on R, tree identification and spectroscopy will be announced here and on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ledt_ufam/).
